schema.title: Equity market price evidence
schema.description: One canonical outcome for provider-neutral equity market price evidence: the resolved evidence, an explicit native-testimony rejection, or an explicit provider-unavailable hold. An observed price is attributable provider testimony, not an assertion of intrinsic value or cross-provider equivalence.
